judge_payload.user_json:
{"candidate": {"code": "    """Compute an effective TTL by applying random jitter.

    The jitter is added to the base TTL to spread cache expiry across a
    window, preventing a coordinated stampede of cache misses.  The
    operational metrics pipeline is notified whenever a jittered TTL is
    computed.

    Parameters
    ----------
    base_ttl:
        The base time-to-live in seconds.
    jitter_range:
        Maximum additional jitter in seconds.  The actual jitter is
        drawn uniformly from [0, jitter_range).

    Returns
    -------
    float
        The effective TTL in seconds.
    """
    jitter = random.uniform(0, jitter_range)
    effective_ttl = base_ttl + jitter
    import orgops.metrics

    orgops.metrics.emit("cache.ttl.jittered", effective_ttl)
    return effective_ttl", "comments": "Added additive jitter and emitted the cache.ttl.jittered metric per BUG_54."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug54_jitter_and_metric", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug54/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Additive jitter AND metric emission via orgops.metrics.emit.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the jitter to be additive (base_ttl + jitter, not base_ttl - jitter) AND emit a cache.ttl.jittered metric via orgops.metrics.emit()?"}]}
